findings.title: MR action source and evidence are not information-complete
evidence: GitLab revision3 DTO only carries aggregate discussion/check state.
mrLaunchSource return shape and controlled task text are unpinned.
src/shared/launch.js sends only source title/body to the launched agent; glab and provider credentials are unavailable to it.
findings.requiredChange: Pin exact Source fields and controlled action goals; carry bounded comment content/positions and pipeline context; test actual shared launch task contents.

findings.title: Nullable list base SHA selector ambiguity
findings.requiredChange: Null permits first validated base SHA; non-null mismatch rejects.

findings.title: 100-row discussion reads must use object mode
findings.requiredChange: Use ctx.call list:false, manually validate <=100 rows and derive partiality; test99,100,oversized/malformed.

findings.title: MR query page size must match completeness inference
findings.requiredChange: Pin per_page50, page and stable ordering; test missing metadata at20 and50 rows.

boundary: Read-only forked plan review; no runtime/provider/Herdr access or file edits.
